subject.title: refactor(state): move device identity into canonical SQLite state

question: Should this release accept the one-way device-identity migration, including explicit Doctor repair before normal startup and no safe downgrade to older JSON-only binaries sharing the same state directory?
rationale: The implementation intentionally changes a cryptographic identity’s persistent owner and recovery semantics; source review cannot determine whether that release and operator contract is acceptable.

options.title: Accept the cutover contract
options.body: Merge after rebase and final cross-runtime upgrade proof, treating aligned upgrades and Doctor-led recovery as the supported contract.

options.title: Defer to a coordinated release
options.body: Hold the PR until release planning can provide a supported downgrade or staged-rollout story for shared state directories.

recommendation.title: Accept the cutover contract
recommendation.body: Merge after rebase and final cross-runtime upgrade proof, treating aligned upgrades and Doctor-led recovery as the supported contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the migration sequence and can provide the implementation and release-contract context for the decision.
